harness.measured_iters: 10 (5 for FFN shapes due to size)

notes: Decode (W=1) is heavily memory-bound: only 6 GOps/s — reading the 4K x 4K int4 weight (8 MiB) once dominates latency. Adreno texture cache + image2d backing (plan §B2) should close most of this gap.
Prefill (W=128) reaches ~410 GOps/s steadily — ~2-4% of the device's peak int8 throughput. Big headroom for work-group / tile / sub-group tuning (Tier S2, A3).

Intel Arc (Meteor Lake-P) on the same kernel runs 3-10x faster than Adreno 830 — strongly suggests the buffer-based access pattern is leaving Adreno's texture cache idle. Adreno is the prime target for the B2 image2d transition next.
Throughput of 1309 GOps/s on Intel Arc at prefill_hidden4096_seq128 vs 411 GOps/s on Adreno: ratio 3.2x. Despite Adreno 830 having higher nominal compute, our kernel isn't reaching its envelope.

For an LLM at seq=128 prefill, FFN up+down at one transformer block = 56 ms on Adreno. 32 blocks => ~1.8 s/128 tokens = ~70 prefill_tok/s before attention/norm overhead. ML Drift target is 1000+ tok/s — current gap > 14x in compute alone.
